annotations.annotation_text: Underground digital havens and outlaw bulletin boards hidden on the fringes of academic and municipal networks where deckers trade stolen passwords, codes, and illicit software.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 87.

annotations.target_phrase: Contents are primarily video recordings of postwar military trials. Central figure is Colonel Willis Corto.
annotations.annotation_text: The discovery of Armitage's suppressed psychiatric past: a decorated Special Forces commander broken during Screaming Fist, whose identity was reconstructed and animated by Wintermute.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 87.
